<!-- Generated by scripts/build_help.py from Puzzle's own data: don't edit. -->


Pick a result in the results bar above the view, or under a run in the model tree. Vectors give a magnitude and components; tensors give components, principal values and an equivalent; units follow Settings → Units.

## Vectors

<!-- key: result:displacement -->
### Deformation

Field `displacement`: Total deformation, and Deformation along X, Y and Z; a length.

<!-- key: result:displacement_amplitude -->
### Deformation amplitude

Field `displacement_amplitude`: Deformation amplitude (all components), and Deformation amplitude along X, Y and Z; a length.

<!-- key: result:displacement_phase -->
### Deformation phase

Field `displacement_phase`: Phase (vector of angles), and Phase, ° along X, Y and Z.

<!-- key: result:velocity -->
### Velocity

Field `velocity`: Velocity magnitude, and Velocity along X, Y and Z; a velocity.

<!-- key: result:heat_flux -->
### Heat flux

Field `heat_flux`: Total heat flux, and Heat flux along X, Y and Z; a heat flux.

<!-- key: result:reaction_force -->
### Reaction force

Field `reaction_force`: Reaction force magnitude, and Reaction force along X, Y and Z; a force.

<!-- key: result:electric_field -->
### Electric field

Field `electric_field`: Electric field magnitude, and Electric field along X, Y and Z.

<!-- key: result:magnetic_flux_density -->
### Magnetic flux density

Field `magnetic_flux_density`: Magnetic flux density magnitude, and Magnetic flux density along X, Y and Z.

<!-- key: result:current_density -->
### Current density

Field `current_density`: Current density magnitude, and Current density along X, Y and Z.

<!-- key: result:magnetic_flux_density_amplitude -->
### Magnetic flux density amplitude

Field `magnetic_flux_density_amplitude`: Magnetic flux density amplitude (all components), and Magnetic flux density amplitude along X, Y and Z.

<!-- key: result:magnetic_flux_density_phase -->
### Magnetic flux density phase

Field `magnetic_flux_density_phase`: Phase (vector of angles), and Phase, ° along X, Y and Z.

<!-- key: result:current_density_amplitude -->
### Current density amplitude

Field `current_density_amplitude`: Current density amplitude (all components), and Current density amplitude along X, Y and Z.

<!-- key: result:lorentz_force_density -->
### Lorentz force density

Field `lorentz_force_density`: Lorentz force density magnitude, and Lorentz force density along X, Y and Z.

<!-- key: result:current_density_phase -->
### Current density phase

Field `current_density_phase`: Phase (vector of angles), and Phase, ° along X, Y and Z.

## Tensors

<!-- key: result:stress -->
### Stress

Field `stress`: the stress components (xx, yy, zz, xy, yz, zx), principal values and an equivalent; a pressure.

<!-- key: result:membrane_stress -->
### Membrane stress (shells)

Field `membrane_stress`: the membrane stress components (xx, yy, zz, xy, yz, zx), principal values and an equivalent; a pressure.

<!-- key: result:strain -->
### Strain

Field `strain`: the strain components (xx, yy, zz, xy, yz, zx), principal values and an equivalent.

<!-- key: result:plastic_strain -->
### Plastic strain

Field `plastic_strain`: the plastic strain components (xx, yy, zz, xy, yz, zx), principal values and an equivalent.

## Scalars

<!-- key: result:plastic_strain_equivalent -->
### Equivalent plastic strain

Field `plastic_strain_equivalent`.

<!-- key: result:temperature -->
### Temperature

Field `temperature`, a temperature.

<!-- key: result:pressure -->
### Pressure

Field `pressure`, a pressure.

<!-- key: result:electric_potential -->
### Electric potential

Field `electric_potential`.

<!-- key: result:contact_pressure -->
### Contact pressure

Field `contact_pressure`, a pressure.

<!-- key: result:contact_shear -->
### Contact frictional stress

Field `contact_shear`, a pressure.

<!-- key: result:contact_gap -->
### Contact gap (− penetration)

Field `contact_gap`, a length.

<!-- key: result:contact_sliding -->
### Contact sliding distance

Field `contact_sliding`, a length.

<!-- key: result:contact_status -->
### Contact status (0 open, 1 sliding, 2 sticking)

Field `contact_status`.

<!-- key: result:error_estimate -->
### Error estimate (energy norm)

Field `error_estimate`.

<!-- key: result:error_ratio -->
### Refinement ratio (above 1: refine)

Field `error_ratio`.

<!-- key: result:error_jump -->
### Gradient jump indicator

Field `error_jump`.

<!-- key: result:loss_density -->
### Loss density (time-averaged)

Field `loss_density`.
